assessmentType: Independent internal assessment of an implemented sandbox hackathon prototype, not an official Devpost result or prize prediction

The default agent-self-evaluation skill was absent at /Users/arnavsingh/.agents/skills/ecc/agent-self-evaluation/SKILL.md, so the supplied rubric was used directly.

verifiedPacket.method: Read each manifest-listed file and compute SHA-256 with Node crypto; no application modules executed. Hash equality confirms consistency with this manifest, not independent provider attestation.

criteria.name: Technological Implementation
criteria.reason: Strong implemented integration for a sandbox prototype: src/rehearsal.js invokes the actual call service, consent gate, checker and receipt builder with isolated mock dependencies; src/call.js binds exact offered money, rechecks before execution, captures sponsor funding before refunding, and uses same-charge reads after a lost response. Retained records support actual sandbox pause/resume, donor relief, paid invoice, verified duplicate-safe webhook, receipt restart survival and separate supplier captures. The current rehearsal and cancellation tests substantiate targeted behavioral coverage. Model routing is useful on the small fresh set but still failed its registered safety gate, and purchase drafting/AI price advantage remain unsupported; that limits a top technical score for this AI prototype.

criteria.name: Design
criteria.reason: A coherent restrained visual system, readable outcome hierarchy and plainly stated financial status make the prototype credible and unusually inspectable. The native completed phone image places the unresolved refund, captured sponsor amount and active gift together; conversation disclosure and native scenario selection support a compact mobile workflow. Labels, live statuses, visible focus treatment and semantic form controls are present in source. The desktop demo gives most of its initial viewport to a large hero and shows only the top of the film, while lengthy conversation and evidence material impose reading effort. The result design is stronger than the initial demo entry hierarchy.

criteria.name: Potential Impact
criteria.reason: The after-hours hardship workflow addresses a concrete donor/nonprofit tension: return an eligible charge while preserving the recurring gift and keeping the sponsor contribution visible. A working sandbox mechanism makes the potential more credible than a concept alone, and the cited fundraising context supports audience relevance without proving this product's effect. There are no independent donor/nonprofit observations, sponsor commitment or evidence of reduced work, retention improvement or sustainable fee coverage. Those unknowns materially constrain confidence in the scale of the proposed benefit; live money, an SLA and a full study are not requirements for this prototype score.

criteria.name: Innovation/Idea
criteria.reason: The distinctive idea is the composition of conversational donor care, sponsor-backed hardship relief, fresh exact consent, authoritative readback, sentence evidence and a verifiable receipt, including visible uncertainty. The optional purchasing desk extends the same execution principles. This is a thoughtful workflow innovation rather than an established first-ever capability: ordinary recurring-gift management already exists, the suppliers are project-controlled, the deterministic guard supplies the demonstrated price protection, and the fresh AI evidence establishes neither broad model superiority nor AI-specific savings. The integrated idea deserves credit while its AI-specific differentiator remains only partly established.

criteria.name: Presentation
criteria.reason: The 73-second lead demonstration has a clear primary donor story, English captions, explicit persistent scope labels and a logical progression through success, consent refusal, changed terms, unresolved refund and receipt tampering. Required frames visibly support the central outcomes, while provenance and captions carefully distinguish simulation from a retained actual sandbox receipt. The anonymous six-scenario rehearsal gives reviewers something concrete to inspect. However, the landing page layers multiple older recordings, procurement totals and an additional chapter player around the primary story; the initial desktop image leaves the film mostly below the fold. Small text in full-browser film frames also requires attention. Full motion, narration delivery and audio quality were not assessed from stills.

materialDeductions.title: AI-specific capability and differentiation remain partial
materialDeductions.evidence: Fresh routing was 11/12 versus rules 6/12, but one wrong mutation route failed the frozen gate; the separate policy repair is not a fresh model win. Purchase drafting failed, and the demonstrated cheaper complete plan came from deterministic guarding. Existing recurring-management alternatives and controlled suppliers limit the extent of the novelty claim.
materialDeductions.improvement: Strengthen the current AI contribution with a fresh frozen evaluation after the policy repair, reporting failures, latency and baseline results alongside any demonstrated advantage.

materialDeductions.title: Promising benefit lacks independent audience and sponsor validation
materialDeductions.evidence: The packet establishes a sandbox mechanism and fundraising context, but no independent target-user observations, measured benefit, sponsor commitment or validated economics. Equal gross capture/refund amounts still incur fees.
materialDeductions.improvement: Validate this same relief workflow with independent donors/nonprofit staff and a concrete sponsor funding/fee arrangement, then report observed friction and practical benefit without extrapolating beyond the evidence.

materialDeductions.title: Strong evidence is presented with avoidable entry and reading friction
materialDeductions.evidence: The native desktop demo image is dominated by the hero and exposes only the upper portion of the primary film. web/demo.html then interleaves several historical films, the staff procurement extension and a chapter player. Film browser frames contain relatively small conversational text, though outcomes are prominent and the mobile completed result is strong.
materialDeductions.improvement: Bring the primary film and rehearsal entry higher in the existing page, condense the initial explanation, and consolidate secondary historical/staff evidence so the donor story is easier to follow.

evidenceSeparation.simulation: The six rehearsal situations use actual application call/gate/relief/checker code, a rules router, fresh mock PayPal, in-memory ledger and fixed virtual clock. No model quality, real provider outage, persistence, external payment or microphone result is inferred from them.
evidenceSeparation.actualProviderRecords: Retained files report actual PayPal sandbox donor capture/refund, pause/resume, paid invoice and verified webhook, plus separate controlled-supplier checkout captures/readbacks. These are historical test-fund records, not newly executed transactions, independent businesses or goods fulfillment. The $676.25 run included a restart; the later $674.15 run did not inject a new one.
evidenceSeparation.failedEvaluations: The fresh donor-routing gate failed despite improved classification count; purchase drafting remained failed and no AI-specific price saving is demonstrated. Historical V4 routing is separate. Policy repair and exposed-case tests do not revise original evaluation outcomes.
evidenceSeparation.receiptScope: App-key Ed25519 integrity of recorded content, not PayPal certification or a live-settlement guarantee.

viewLimits: Inspected six required original-resolution images, film captions/provenance, current allowed source/tests and listed retained financial/evaluation reports. The film file was hashed but full motion and audio were not played or independently decoded during this assessment.
No browser/hosted interaction, external provider query, payment, model request, credentials/runtime access, user contact or application mutation occurred.
Tests were read, not rerun. Full-suite counts, hosted acceptance, deployed commit and decode/playback claims remain packet-reported evidence rather than new independent runtime observations.
All 74 manifest-listed hashes matched; listed JSON reports/docs/tests outside that manifest were read as supplied and their historical provenance was not independently authenticated.

No prior subjective grades, earlier packets or prior score reports were opened. Public video upload, public refreshed source release, Devpost submission and full official rules compliance are not established and were kept separate from the five scores.
conclusion: A strong, inspectable sandbox hackathon prototype with unusually concrete payment/consent evidence and polished outcome views. Its best-supported achievement is controlled execution and honest evidence, while AI advantage, audience benefit and the entry presentation leave material room to improve. This is an internal prototype assessment, not an official judging result.
